# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Honeycomb Burns; Aseneth Sees a Vision of the Eighth Heaven

---

**12:1** And the man of God stretched out his right hand and traced upon the honeycomb with his finger from east to west, and his finger's track became fire, and it burned up the comb. But no smoke arose from the burning of the comb.

**12:2** And Aseneth was amazed at the sight and trembled with great fear.

**12:3** And the man of God said to Aseneth: 'Did you see this thing?' And she said: 'Yes, lord, I saw it all.'

**12:4** And the man said to her: 'So also shall be the words of my mouth, whether sweet like honey or whether burning like fire, so that they burn up the enemies of the righteous.'

**12:5** And Aseneth said to the man: 'Lord, I have seven virgin companions who have been raised with me from my youth. I wish to call them, so that you may bless them also as you have blessed me.'

**12:6** And the man said: 'Call them.' And Aseneth called the seven virgins and the man blessed them and said: 'The Lord God Most High will bless you, and you shall be like the seven pillars of the City of Refuge, and all the elect of that city will rest upon you for ever.'

**12:7** And the man said to Aseneth: 'Remove the table.' And Aseneth turned to remove the table, and immediately the man of God was carried up in a fiery chariot toward the heavens.

**12:8** And Aseneth said: 'Foolish and bold was I, who spoke with such boldness before the man of God. For behold, I did not know that he was a son of God, and he said to me that my name was to be written in the book of the living in heaven.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
